_note: 英語島文法分區 sidecar：一檔一單元一 KP。unit_id＝KP id＝eng.t_adv.pattern.sentence-types（句型辨識，t_adv 學測級）。依『子句結構』分四型：簡單句＝一個獨立子句（可有複合主詞/複合動詞，仍一子句）；合句（compound）＝兩個以上獨立子句用對等連接詞 FANBOYS（for/and/nor/but/or/yet/so）＋逗號，或用分號連接；複句（complex）＝一個獨立子句＋至少一個由從屬連接詞（because/although/when/if/since/while/that…）引導的從屬子句；複合句（compound-complex）＝兩個以上獨立子句＋至少一個從屬子句。易混點：I finished my homework and watched TV.＝簡單句（複合動詞、單一主詞）。MCQ 每題唯一可辯護正解＋distractor_rationales＋answer_evidence。R14：teach body 全英文、中文放 zh_hint。以 Swan/Cambridge/Oxford 查證、status provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。含純文字 shadowing（無音檔）。

units.title_zh: 句型辨識（簡單句／合句／複句／複合句）
units.can_do: 我能依子句結構分辨四種句型：簡單句（一個獨立子句）、合句（對等連接詞 FANBOYS 或分號連兩個獨立子句）、複句（含從屬子句）、複合句（兩個以上獨立子句＋從屬子句）。
units.situation_group: 句型：句子結構 Sentence types
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A simple sentence has one independent clause — one complete subject-and-verb idea. It can still have a compound subject or a compound verb and remain one clause: 'Tom and Jerry ran and played.'
claims.verification_ref: 簡單句＝一個獨立子句（可有複合主詞/複合動詞仍為一子句，如 Tom and Jerry ran and played）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A compound sentence joins two or more independent clauses with a coordinating conjunction (FANBOYS: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so), usually after a comma, or with a semicolon: 'I wanted to go, but it was too late.'
claims.verification_ref: 合句＝兩個以上獨立子句用對等連接詞 FANBOYS（for/and/nor/but/or/yet/so）＋逗號或用分號連接（I wanted to go, but it was too late）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A complex sentence has one independent clause and at least one dependent (subordinate) clause introduced by a subordinating conjunction (because, although, when, if, since, while, etc.): 'We stayed inside because it was raining.'
claims.verification_ref: 複句＝一個獨立子句＋至少一個由從屬連接詞（because/although/when/if/since/while…）引導的從屬子句（We stayed inside because it was raining）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A compound-complex sentence has two or more independent clauses and at least one dependent clause: 'When the bell rang, the students left, and the teacher cleaned the board.'
claims.verification_ref: 複合句＝兩個以上獨立子句＋至少一個從屬子句（When the bell rang, the students left, and the teacher cleaned the board）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: We can sort sentences by how their clauses are built. An independent clause can stand alone as a sentence; a dependent clause cannot. A simple sentence has one independent clause. It may have a compound subject or a compound verb and still count as one clause.
teach.zh_hint: 句子可依『子句怎麼組成』來分類。獨立子句能單獨成句；從屬子句不行。簡單句＝一個獨立子句；就算有複合主詞或複合動詞，仍算一個子句。

teach.body: Simple: The children played in the park. / Tom and Jerry ran and played. (compound subject + compound verb, still one clause)
teach.zh_hint: 簡單句：The children played in the park.（一個獨立子句）Tom and Jerry ran and played.（複合主詞＋複合動詞，仍是一個子句）

teach.body: A compound sentence joins two or more independent clauses. Join them with a coordinating conjunction — the FANBOYS: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so — usually after a comma, or join them with a semicolon.
teach.zh_hint: 合句連接兩個以上獨立子句。用對等連接詞 FANBOYS（for、and、nor、but、or、yet、so）＋逗號，或用分號（;）來連接。

teach.body: Compound: I finished my homework, so I watched TV. / It was late; everyone went home.
teach.zh_hint: 合句：I finished my homework, so I watched TV.（兩個獨立子句＋逗號＋so）It was late; everyone went home.（用分號連接兩個獨立子句）

teach.body: A complex sentence has one independent clause plus at least one dependent clause. The dependent clause begins with a subordinating conjunction such as because, although, when, if, since, or while. A compound-complex sentence has two or more independent clauses and at least one dependent clause.
teach.zh_hint: 複句＝一個獨立子句＋至少一個從屬子句；從屬子句以從屬連接詞開頭（because、although、when、if、since、while 等）。複合句＝兩個以上獨立子句＋至少一個從屬子句。

teach.body: Complex: Because it rained, we stayed home. / Compound-complex: When the bell rang, the students left, and the teacher cleaned the board.
teach.zh_hint: 複句：Because it rained, we stayed home.（從屬子句 Because it rained ＋獨立子句）複合句：When the bell rang, the students left, and the teacher cleaned the board.（兩個獨立子句＋一個從屬子句 When…）

practice.stem: 下列哪一句是簡單句（只有一個獨立子句）？
practice.answer: My brother washed the car on Saturday morning.
options: My brother washed the car on Saturday morning.
My brother washed the car, and he cleaned the garage.
My brother washed the car because it was muddy.
Although he was tired, my brother washed the car, and he cleaned the garage.

distractor_rationales.My brother washed the car, and he cleane: 用逗號＋對等連接詞 and 連接兩個獨立子句，是合句。
distractor_rationales.My brother washed the car because it was: 含一個由 because 引導的從屬子句，是複句。
distractor_rationales.Although he was tired, my brother washed: 有兩個獨立子句（my brother washed the car／he cleaned the garage）＋一個從屬子句（Although…），是複合句。

practice.feedback: My brother washed the car on Saturday morning：只有一個獨立子句，是簡單句。

practice.stem: 下列哪一句是合句（兩個獨立子句用對等連接詞 FANBOYS 連接）？
practice.answer: I cooked dinner, so we ate together.
options: I cooked dinner, so we ate together.
After I cooked dinner, we ate together.
I cooked dinner and set the table.

After 是從屬連接詞，引導從屬子句，這是複句，不是合句。
and 連接的是兩個動詞（複合動詞），只有一個主詞、一個子句，仍是簡單句。
只有一個獨立子句，是簡單句。

practice.feedback: I cooked dinner, so we ate together：逗號＋對等連接詞 so 連接兩個獨立子句，是合句。

practice.stem: 『Although she was tired, she kept working.』這句是哪一種句型？

distractor_rationales.簡單句: 這句有兩個子句（Although she was tired ＋ she kept working），不只一個，不是簡單句。
distractor_rationales.合句: 兩個子句不是用對等連接詞 FANBOYS 連接，而是用從屬連接詞 Although，所以是複句不是合句。
distractor_rationales.複合句: 複合句需要兩個以上『獨立』子句；這句只有一個獨立子句（she kept working）＋一個從屬子句，是複句。

practice.feedback: Although she was tired（從屬子句）＋ she kept working（獨立子句）＝複句。

practice.stem: 下列哪一個是對等連接詞（FANBOYS），可用來把兩個獨立子句連成合句？

distractor_rationales.because: because 是從屬連接詞，引導表原因的從屬子句，連成的是複句而非合句。
distractor_rationales.although: although 是從屬連接詞，引導表讓步的從屬子句，連成複句。
distractor_rationales.when: when 是從屬連接詞，引導表時間的從屬子句，連成複句。

practice.feedback: FANBOYS＝for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so；but 是對等連接詞，連兩個獨立子句成合句。

practice.stem: 選出能把兩句合成一個複句（表原因）的從屬連接詞：We canceled the trip ____ the storm was dangerous.（因為暴風雨很危險，我們取消了旅行）

distractor_rationales.so: so 是對等連接詞，連成的是合句，且 so 表結果不表原因；要表原因且成複句用 because。
distractor_rationales.but: but 是對等連接詞（表轉折），連成合句，語意也不合『原因』。
distractor_rationales.and: and 是對等連接詞，連成合句，也表達不出『原因』。

practice.feedback: because 是從屬連接詞、表原因，引導從屬子句 → We canceled the trip because the storm was dangerous（複句）。

practice.stem: 下列哪一句是複合句（兩個以上獨立子句＋至少一個從屬子句）？
practice.answer: When the movie ended, we went home, and we talked about it.
options: When the movie ended, we went home, and we talked about it.
When the movie ended, we went home.
We went home, and we talked about it.
We went home after the movie.

一個獨立子句（we went home）＋一個從屬子句（When…），是複句，沒有第二個獨立子句。
兩個獨立子句用 and 連接，是合句，沒有從屬子句。
只有一個獨立子句（after the movie 是介系詞片語、非子句），是簡單句。

practice.feedback: we went home ／ we talked about it（兩個獨立子句）＋ When the movie ended（從屬子句）＝複合句。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀出每句，一邊讀一邊數『有幾個獨立子句、有沒有從屬連接詞』，再判斷句型。讀到連接詞處稍作停頓。

lines.text: I wanted to go out, but it was raining.
lines.intonation: but 前稍停頓（合句的連接點）、句尾下收

lines.text: When the bell rang, the students left, and the teacher cleaned the board.
lines.intonation: 逗號處停頓、讀出三個區塊（從屬子句＋兩個獨立子句）
